review_text: This place was recommended by Google, and it seems the locals like it too, so I'll give it a try. They must have great coffee because the place is tiny compared to other coffee shops I've been to in the past.

I’ve been going to Glasshouse since my college days, and I used to really like this place. But lately, the customer service has been disappointing. On several visits, the staff barely interact with customers. No “hello,” no “good morning/good afternoon, etc,”no greetings at all. Just serving poker face lol. They just ask for your order and place the drinks/food down on your table. The vibe feels cold, like the staff looked unhappy like they don’t want to be there, which makes the experience uncomfortable. If it happened once, I would understand maybe someone was just having a bad day. But it’s happened multiple times now, so it feels like a regular issue. It doesn’t hurt to smile or greet customers. I hope this improves because the place itself has potential, but the attitude of the staff made the experience awful.

Just beside the Huckleberry resto and bar. The place is somehow small but relaxing. Good thing it wasn’t crowded when we visited there on a weekend. They have a lot of options for drinks, you can also opt for oat milk. They have displayed books if you want to read while sipping your fave coffee drink.

This is actually a late review but I don't want to miss it. It is one of the most beautiful coffee shops I've been to. Glasshouse Coffee is near Tola. The ambiance was so nice. The playlist they had was calming. Their bagel was good and their carrot cake, too. We love their brownies and cookies and we took it home since we weren't able to finish it. We really love the place and I'd like to come back again to try more from their menu. I already forgot if they have an internet connection but because of the serenity of the place, it's a good spot to be alone or to study.

At this moment I feel like I am inside an aquarium. It's cool but I feel the need to surface for oxygen. The flat white is small. The carrot cake is good and sweet. The aircon is cold. But 330p for a tiny coffee and a piece of cake? This is the developing Philippines. What will happen in the next 5 or 10 years???

Overall a good coffee shop experience, even greater thank normal because they have the roastery inside the shop, spreading the aroma of freshly roasted coffee inside. The staff was knowledgable about their beans and was able to recommend one that fits my preference of chocolatey and earthy without the floral fruity notes, dark roast of course, and paired it with caramel to bring out the coffee that I wanted. The atmosphere, to me, was really nice, and the concept of a glass house with wooden structures made it feel like I was in a Korean Hanok or okd japanese houses
Love the place. Great coffee. But no WiFi and many many mosquitoes. I understand you prefer people to stay to chat and read but sometimes we have another needs, like open laptop and do random stuff.

This is such a quaint local coffeeshop that's situated inside the premises of Tola and Huckleberry restaurant. The interior feels very laid back and chill, and you can defintly enjoy reading a book here since not a lot of people can fit inside the cafe. As for the drinks, they tasted good as coffee goes. I thoroughly enjoyed their bacon and egg sandwhich which I recommend. They also have pastries too! Overall, would definitely come back!

I frequently come here to read because the atmosphere is cozy + they have a good selection of books if you didn’t bring yours. Frequently get the chocolate chip cookies and their bacon, egg and cheese sandwich doesn’t disappoint. Pics from a recent women’s brewing roundtable event i attended and enjoyed :)

Glasshouse Coffee is my go-to coffee shop in Davao City. I always order Iced Americano, paired it with plain croissant. I usually go here to pass time whenever I run some errands in the city or relax before mountain climbing the next day. The location is a reminder of how green spaces make things even better. Trees around, ornamentals, flowers... I like the vibe. The coffee shop is small and has a limited indoor seating capacity. It can accommodate around 10-15 people.

The Glasshouse. This place is very nice and comfy vibe to it. The space is very small (which is actually quite nice since cafes in the city are too big and crowded) so you’d expect small crowds too perfect for study, chill or just some alone time. They have a small menu since they have a small kitchen. They serve some cakes to pair up with your beverage. They have outdoor sitting which has a nice setting too because the place is surrounded with lush green garden they tend to.

Ambiance and coffee is really good. It amuses me that they are using vinyl record/cassettes for music. The reservation is organized too, to avoid being crowded. If I may suggest, snacks like pastry, bread, sandwiches or pastas can be added on the menu to complement the coffee.
Great coffee place! The claim of being a "specialty coffee shop" is legit and I love the shop already. It's so peaceful in here. I will definitely come back once I'm in Davao again.

I like the place. It’s quite relaxing. The plants are giving the fresh and peaceful vibe. The only problem is, I find it hard to locate the address on google map as there is no sign board along the highway.

What a coffee gem in Davao. The cafe is surrounded by a lush garden--trees and plants blooming. The wooden interiors give off a calming vibe. There was soft jazz and acoustics playing, too, so you'll really enjoy your stay. Ordered their bestselling Flat White and Carrot Walnut cake. Coffee was great! Bold coffee and just the right creaminess. Carrot cake was scrumptious, sarap ng cream cheese! The lady who served me was very very kind and accommodating, assisting me with water and where the comfort room is. Worked here for 3 hours. No wifi but great data signal. Quiet and peaceful pa!

This is my second visit after a long time. I ordered a non-coffee double chocolate drink and chocolate chip cookies. For those who want to bring their work here, they don't have wifi so it's better to have your own consumable data.

Savoring life's simple pleasures, like a perfect cup of coffee of Glasshouse. The place is quiet but nice. It's just best for small group of people since the place is not too big. The shop can remove the unused space instead for others can occupy.

I visit at least three times a week, and it's like the staff aren't happy; they don't even say good morning (parang di marunong mag smile). It feels like they aren't willing to serve you. I’ve been a regular since 2022, and it’s just different compared to back then.
Cozy environment, Small furnitures and Low Ceiling clearance. Don't expect to give you WiFi password, when it's clearly have WiFi available.

One of the best carrot cakes we've ever tasted and best paired with hot choco. A hidden gem of great value finds. You're only limited to a couple of seats though and it's best if you don't bring your vehicle unless you want to park your car in the resto. Would definitely come back.
The ambiance was really great even though the place was small. The coffee and the snacks are of superb quality. I’ve been wanting to go back just to taste their concoctions again.

This Coffeeshop is very small inside a glass cube... Yeah this is a positive... Once u enter u can get 105% Coffee Aroma pumping! That itself would say the quality of coffee bean they use... And the Ambience 💯 natural... Best Part is the Bamboo Straws... Very good place to Study... Quite place perfect for a Coffee and a talk... It's good if u are a couple or 3... Won't be good if you are 4 or more...

Excellent coffee, this place is a million times better than mainstream coffee shops. First time that I did not need sugar with my coffee. Artisanship at it's finest. And hospitable staff, too. Will recommend to my friends.

A hidden gem in the city. The place is so amazingly cozy and relaxing. It also has this modern feel to it riddled with subtle rustic pieces that I quite like. The music playlist being played varies between british indie and contemporary ballads. The staff is very attentive and friendly. Their food ranges from 100 to 200 pesos. Serving is quite small but is perfectly warm and delicious. P.S. do try their hot choco and matcha green tea ❤
A nice place to work or study. Nice ambience. Serves good coffee and their cookies were good. May saksakan if you need to plug-in some devices.
Very nice ambiance, coffee selection is great. A nice venue for get together.

We went there around noon thinking we could grab a bite so we had their bagels and it was heaven. I haven't tried out the coffee but my friends gave it full marks. You should visit it sometime tho I suggest around dusk and later will be a better idea.

Glasshouse Coffee is very clean and green. It's the perfect place to sit down, read a book and drink good coffee. The place might be a bit hidden from plain sight when you get to the area. You have to go inside the Oboza Compound and check the front of the Oboza Heritage House. From there, you'll see the coffee shop in a literal glasshouse. Once inside, you can try out their coffee and stay for a bit in the garden-themed cafe.
the atmosphere is great. perfect for studying. ang mahal lang talaga ng drinks & they're not really that mindblowing. the matcha is good tho! i'd come back here again.
The highlight here is the ambiance of the cafe. Matcha drink I had was not good. Also, they’re quite pricey for their quality of offerings.

It seems to me this is a hidden gem. A glass house surrounded by greenery, flowers and a few geckos on the outside glass and it’s very quiet even though it is on a busy street. I had the Carmel Iced Latte and is was very good as I sat, read and relaxed.
tried their sansrival, not worth the price. ambiance is ok, tried the coffee Americano, same same. will go here for the place,since its relaxing but will not recommend the foods i ordered.

Cozy and reasonably-priced. With a good book, you could spend hours here.

I love this coffee shop! If I lived in Davao I'd spend days here just relaxing. The place is great and coffee is reasonably priced.
Really good coffee and ambiance but the thing I noticed there's a food trash outside seems like from last night and the floor looks like it was not cleaned.
Matcha latte was just okay. Fudge brownie was good!! Want to try their salmon bagel next time

Clean and quiet coffee place that opens early. Limited items on the menu. Alert and courteous lone staff that 10:00 a.m. I was there….. Enjoyed the cappuccino and carrot walnut cake before running to do errands. Will definitely be back to try their bagels…..
I love the ambiance plus their coffee was lit ♥ 🔥 …

Met up with a friend here! It's located inside a guarded compound with a good ambiance and friendly staff. Also, this place is photo worthy ❤️ one thing tho, is that they only have a limited choices of drinks and snacks. So, it was a bummer when they didn't have any type of matcha drink. Still, I enjoyed our time here ❤️

I only have good memories of this place and I don't even like coffee lol. But the ambiance is fantastic as well as the customer service. The best thing I remember about this coffee shop is their playlist. Music from spectacular Japanese artists just complemented the mood of rain falling onto glass walls. I need to come back soon.
Nice and cozy, although the space is tiny. No wifi, so connect physically with the one who matters most to you 😊 …
Brownies was really good!
Cozy, intimate, peaceful place for artists and writers to catch up and rekindle their passion over a cup of coffee.

My favorite coffee place in Davao. The vibe is perfect for relaxing and being creative. It may not be that spacious inside but once you got your own space, you are sure to enjoy the coffee and the experience.
It was a really nice place. Would love to visit again soon. Cebu to Davao🤍🤍🤍

It’s a nice pleasant place like an oasis in the middle of the hustle and bustle of the city. Coffee was great, but I wouldn’t recommend the carrot cake. Perfect place to relax and enjoy a cup of coffee or work if you need a place to.
A pleasant place for pleasant conversations over coffee. Tasty coffee, you can eat cake. Too bad there's no toilet. The location is also nice becouse there is lots of plants.
Nice atmosphere and the service is okay but the food leaves a lot to be desired. Just very sugary oatmeal cookies and salmon bagels. The coffee is nice but the cups are far too small.

A very relaxing place and one of the must-visit when you go to Davao City. It has a reading corner--offers books and magazines for the customers to read. They also have the blank notebooks where you can write anything, just anything at all- a confession, a poem, a short message, and you can even do doodle. Their service is good, and their food products even better.
Good place for a coffee date. I also had the smoked salmon bagel. Just didn’t take any pictures of the food oops. But it’s worth the walk if you are nearby.
People go here for the coffee. Despite the limited food choices, they all taste great and go well with their drinks. The modern design brings it all together. Things to improve: speed of service.

This humble place nestled in the middle of the city is a great place to grab a good cup of coffee. Staying here really takes you away from the hustle and bustle of the city. It just makes you forget that this place is in the middle of town with all the greenery that surround its seethrough walls.

MY GO-TO COFFEE SHOP FOR CATCHING UP WITH MY FRIENDS, JOURNAL, SELF-DATES, ETC. Aside from the therapeutic, nature- feels place, the latte is so good!! My favorite is their cookies combined with my affogato/latte. You should also try their brownies and bagels. ☺💯 …
Looking for a quiet coffee shop in the heart of davao city? please try and visit Glasshouse Coffee!

Go to place for good coffee & cookie in Davao. Always a pleasure.
It's cozy and quite. The coffee shop is connected to bar I like this coffee shop. There's not so many people. I can enjoy my own time with coffee

If you love coffee, cake and ambiance all in one this is the place to go best in the world so far!!!!
